title: Canonical condensed compact-support coefficient projection
statement: Let $a:\Lambda\to\Lambda'$ be a morphism of commutative condensed rings, with scalar extension preserving finite limits on each small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. Let $c=(X\xrightarrow{j}Z\xrightarrow{g}Y)$ be a compactification [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. On the archived internal-module ordinary derived categories put $P_\Lambda^c=Rg_{*,\Lambda}j_{!,\Lambda}$ and $T_a^W=\Lambda'_W\otimes^L_{\Lambda_W}-$, with the canonical scalar/restriction adjunction [def-weil-pbc-condensed-coefficient-comparisons]. The open operation is the actual exact sheafified extension by zero [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact]. Define $T_a^Y P_\Lambda^c\to P_{\Lambda'}^c T_a^X$ by pasting the original proper coefficient counit mate $T_a^Y Rg_{*,\Lambda}\to Rg_{*,\Lambda'}T_a^Z$ with the original open scalar comparison $T_a^Z j_{!,\Lambda}\to j_{!,\Lambda'}T_a^X$. Use the tensor associator and unit induced by the actual restriction-of-scalars composition and identity. For a compactification refinement $r:c\to d$ and bounded constructible $K$ on $X$, define $P_\Lambda^dK\to P_\Lambda^cK$ by applying $Rg_{d,*}$ to the unique arrow $j_{d,!}K\to Rr_*j_{c,!}K$ whose open-adjunction transpose, followed by inverse-image composition and the proper counit of $r$, equals the original open unit for $j_c$; then apply the proper-image compositor. Retain this normalization before asserting invertibility. The coefficient projections commute with canonical shifts, tensor units and successive coefficient maps, and with these refinement arrows on bounded constructible inputs whose scalar extension is bounded constructible. Refinement arrows have the stated identity and composition normalization. These definitions apply also to a finite-extension-valued algebraic-closure coefficient ring; no invertibility of the coefficient projection is built into its definition.

proof.text: For identityScalar_flat, identify coefficientMap of the identity with the identity ring map. Compose Mod.extendScalarsIsoOfEq with Mod.extendScalarsId and transport finite-limit preservation from the identity functor with preservesFiniteLimits_of_natIso. No coefficient-flatness hypothesis is used.
proof.elementary: The existing coefficientMap_id and tensor-unit isomorphism identify this functor with the identity; finite-limit preservation is invariant under natural isomorphism.

proof.text: For condensedProjection_commShift, use the canonical right-derived unit shift calculation from lem-sp-canonical-right-derived-adjunction-shift. The factorization equation for each right-derived comparison is a shift-compatible composite. On K-injective representatives the source derived unit is invertible, so NatTrans.CommShift.of_comp_whiskerLeft_Qh gives shift compatibility of right-derived natural isomorphisms, exact-functor identifications, and composition identifications. Apply these to derivedComapLowerStarIso. The levelwise derived pullback comparison commutes with shifts as well. Equip scalar adjunctions with the shifts already specified by condensedScalarShift; their units and counits commute with shifts by commShift_of_rightAdjoint. The exact open adjunctions commute with the levelwise shifts. Expand the proper scalar mate and the open conjugate: every unit, counit, comparison, associator and whiskering commutes with shifts. Their paste is condensedProjection, so it commutes with shifts. The seven other original coherence and refinement theorems retain their source proof plans and original holes in the Lean docstrings.

For fieldRefinement_id, take the right-adjoint conjugate of the existing leftDerivedUpperStarId as the proper pushforward identity isomorphism. The proved right unit law for leftDerivedUpperStarComp identifies the identity refinement restriction with the pullback of this isomorphism. Under the open adjunction, the inverse proper identity satisfies the original normalization; fieldProperOpen_existsUnique therefore identifies it with fieldProperOpen. The proved left unit law for leftDerivedUpperStarComp, transported through conjugateEquiv, identifies fieldPushComp at the identity with the proper identity. Their two components cancel after the proper direct image, proving the identity natural transformation.
proof.elementary: Uses the already proved source-library pullback unit laws in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.ProEtale.ModuleObject.Derived.UpperStarCoherence, Mathlib adjunction mate identities, and the original fieldProperOpen_existsUnique declaration in this node; no new assumption.
